summary: Intercept a core if statement and lower two return blocks into a lazy conditional helper without procedural token inspection.

capabilities.requirement: Support the rewritten if experiment from the playground.
Intercept if only under an explicit lexical syntax import.
Match return statements inside both balanced branch blocks through declarative patterns.
Consume the predicate and each returned value as complete expressions.
Resolve the emitted IF helper at the macro definition even when the call site binds IF.

syntaxNotes: The first contract accepts an if-else whose branches each contain one return statement.
Both branch values remain lazy arrow-function bodies.
Later rules may add nested else-if and statement prefixes without procedural expansion hooks.

openDecisions.question: Ship declarative core-form interception in the first release?
